description: This Java class models a GLClosure (General Ledger Closure) entity for the Fineract accounting system. It manages closure data such as associated office, closure date, comments, and handles creation and updates based on JSON commands.

classes.name: GLClosure
classes.description: Represents a ledger closure with attributes for office, closure date, comments, and deletion status. It provides static creation from JSON and an update mechanism.

methods.name: GLClosure
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GLClosure with office, closing date, and optional comments.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a GLClosure instance from a JSON command and associated office.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates mutable properties such as comments based on provided JSON command and returns the set of changes.

methods.name: handlePropertyUpdate
methods.description: Helper method to handle updating a specific property if a change is detected in the JSON command.
